summary: The PROJEXA-side code itself (Permits create, new Drawings & 3D and Minutes of Meeting screens, Documents upload, callVeridianUpload multipart client, sidebar/i18n additions) is clean, correctly scoped to tier1 (no schema/migration/auth-path changes), follows this repo's existing requireAuth()+callVeridian() proxy conventions, honestly discloses the WhatsApp-send gap in the UI (disabled button with tooltip) instead of faking it, and passes a local `tsc --noEmit` clean. However, it has a hard runtime dependency on new compliance-tracker backend endpoints -- POST /api/v1/documents, POST and project/all-scoped GET /api/v1/projexa/permits, and the entirely new /api/v1/projexa/drawings and /api/v1/projexa/veri-meetings routes -- that only exist on an unmerged compliance-tracker branch (feat/projexa-permits-drawings-moms, confirmed pushed to origin but with no PR opened, per gh pr list). compliance-tracker's actual main branch still has only the old GET-only, non-project-scoped permits route and no documents POST, drawings, or veri-meetings routes at all (verified directly against origin/main). If this PROJEXA PR is merged and auto-deployed per the standing tier1 pipeline, real users would immediately see two new sidebar nav items (Drawings & 3D, Minutes of Meeting) that 404/502 on load, Permit/Document create-upload dialogs that fail on submit, and the Permits list silently ignoring its new projectId/all query params (old backend route doesn't recognize them) and falling back to an unscoped organization-wide expiring list instead of erroring -- a silent incorrect-data regression, not just a hard failure. The worker's own PROGRESS.md already flagged this ordering problem as unresolved. This is a cross-repo deployment-ordering defect, not a workflows-file issue (no .github/workflows/** touched here).
issues: Runtime dependency on compliance-tracker endpoints (POST /api/v1/documents, POST+scoped-GET /api/v1/projexa/permits, new /api/v1/projexa/drawings, new /api/v1/projexa/veri-meetings) that do not exist on compliance-tracker's main branch -- they live only on branch feat/projexa-permits-drawings-moms, which is pushed but has no PR and is not merged. Merging this PROJEXA diff now ships broken UI to production before its backend half exists.

Permits GET now sends projectId/all=true query params that the currently-deployed backend route does not parse; it will silently ignore them and return the old organization-wide expiring-permits list rather than the intended project-scoped list -- a silent data-scoping regression until the backend branch is merged.

No PROJEXA-side tests were added for the new/changed proxy routes (api/permits, api/drawings, api/documents POST, api/moms/*), and the worker's own PROGRESS.md admits tsc/test were never run against PROJEXA in-session (I ran tsc --noEmit myself here and it is clean, but no test coverage exists for the new routes).

Recommended follow-up: open and merge the compliance-tracker PR for branch feat/projexa-permits-drawings-moms first (with its own review), then re-review/merge this PROJEXA PR, or hold both until they can land together.
